embedding.note: V3 concatenates eight global 0–100 movement scores with thirty key-position axis values, each globally min-max normalized to 0–100 across all poses. The two blocks are then z-scored and divided by the square root of their dimensionality before PCA so both blocks contribute equally.

mediapipe.inputMode: Body_with_Diagram with Body fallback only when the primary image has no detected pose
mediapipe.coordinateSystem: world coordinates recentered at the hip midpoint and divided by median torso scale
